label: A vehicle, mount, carried-gear or locomotion token (truck, bus, horse, backpack, walk, drive) whose preceding context places it at rest or in place - parked, tied up, listed as a facility or amenity, used as an object, moving about within a confined spot - rather than travelling along a route toward a destination; the - pole takes the en-route / along / escort reading of the same words.

probed_before.source: this checkout's .probe-log, before the pre-registration commit

short: vehicle at rest, not en route
notes: Probes (fraction of max 17.75) split on the frame BEFORE the token, not the token. Matched pairs: ' truck' 0.475 in a facility list ('car park, petrol station and a truck wash') and 0.209 in 'keys in the truck parked' vs 0.067 after 'rumbling along the dusty highway'; ' backpack' 0.498 used as a pillow vs 0.165 'hikers shouldered their backpacks and set off'; ' walk' 0.608 'chairs surrounded me ... had to walk around' vs ' walking' 0.021 'down the dark street'. Also 'tied his horse to the post' 0.403; 'aircraft to park ... service vehicles' 0.400 (peak ' vehicles'); 'parked the van' 0.326; 'with bus transportation' 0.474 vs 'patrol cars roared alongside, escorting' 0.118. Meaning without a locomotion token does not fire: 'paced around the kitchen' 0.011. - pole mirror: ' along' x4, ' escort', ' driving', 'had to walk the 2 km' (-0.73 of -max); logits suppress ' journey', ' along', ' route', promote ' static', ' vacant'. Fire items copy the 0.40-0.61 configs with the at-rest cue in LEFT context (list with 'overnight parking', 'and bus service', dismounted horse, backpack sat on, cramped-kitchen walk, 'parked a fuel truck', parking talk then 'just drive' = corpus 0.74, 'parked ... stood an old truck'). Near misses keep the same single tokens (tokenizer-verified) and put a route cue (along, across the valley, into the climb, into the journey, mile after mile) BEFORE the token. Caveats: 'means of transportation' with no left context scored 0.12, so the cue must precede the noun; peaks smear onto the next token; half the corpus top-16 is non-English, tested in English only.
